alisha-baby-talk.intro: "Baby Talk" is a 1985 single by the freestyle and dance-pop singer Alisha. Her version reached No. 1 on the Billboard Hot Dance Club Songs chart in December 1985.

andy-warhol-s-fifteen-minutes.intro: Andy Warhol's Fifteen Minutes is an American talk show hosted by Andy Warhol that aired on MTV from 1985 to 1987, one of the network's earliest series.

anything-but-love.intro: Anything but Love is an American sitcom that aired on ABC from 1989 to 1992. Richard Lewis and Jamie Lee Curtis play coworkers at a Chicago magazine who try to keep their relationship strictly professional.

behind-the-velvet-ropes.intro: Behind the Velvet Ropes was an American fashion television series hosted by the journalist Lauren Ezersky. It began on public-access television in New York City in 1984, ran for more than two decades and later reached the Style Network.

big-top-pee-wee.intro: Big Top Pee-wee is a 1988 American comedy directed by Randal Kleiser, a standalone sequel to Pee-wee's Big Adventure with Paul Reubens as Pee-wee Herman.

birdcage.intro: The Birdcage is a 1996 American comedy produced and directed by Mike Nichols. Elaine May's screenplay adapts the 1978 French-Italian film La Cage aux Folles.

black-box.intro: Black Box is an Italian house music group popular in the late 1980s and early 1990s, made up of DJ Daniele Davoli, Valerio Semplici and Mirko Limoni.

black-box-everybody-everybody.intro: "Everybody Everybody" is a 1990 song by the Italian house group Black Box, from their debut album Dreamland. It was written by Daniele Davoli, Mirko Limoni and Valerio Semplici.

blondie.intro: Blondie is an American rock band formed in New York City in 1974 by Debbie Harry and Chris Stein. Coming out of the CBGB punk scene, they had worldwide success with their third album, Parallel Lines (1978).

bongwater.intro: Bongwater was an American psychedelic rock band, formed in 1987 and dissolved in 1992. It was founded by Ann Magnuson and Mark Kramer, who had worked together in Pulsallama.

c-c-music-factory.intro: C+C Music Factory was an American group formed in 1989 by David Cole and Robert Clivillés, best known for the hits "Gonna Make You Sweat", "Here We Go" and "Things That Make You Go Hmmm...".

c-c-music-factory-gonna-make-you-sweat.intro: "Gonna Make You Sweat (Everybody Dance Now)" is a song by C+C Music Factory, released by Columbia Records on 10 October 1990 as the lead single from their debut album Gonna Make You Sweat.

facts.label: By
facts.value: C+C Music Factory featuring Freedom Williams

facts.label: Written by
facts.value: David Cole, Robert Clivillés and Freedom Williams

cookie.intro: Cookie is a 1989 American crime comedy directed by Susan Seidelman, starring Peter Falk, Emily Lloyd and Dianne Wiest.

deep-in-vogue.intro: "Deep in Vogue" is a 1989 dance single by Malcolm McLaren and the Bootzilla Orchestra featuring Lourdes Maria Morales and Willie Ninja, sampling the 1973 MFSB song "Love Is the Message".

facts.label: By
facts.value: Malcolm McLaren and the Bootzilla Orchestra

desperately-seeking-susan.intro: Desperately Seeking Susan is a 1985 American comedy-drama film directed by Susan Seidelman and starring Rosanna Arquette, Aidan Quinn and Madonna. Set in New York City, the mistaken-identity plot links a bored housewife and a bohemian drifter through messages in the personals section of a newspaper.

devil-wears-prada.intro: The Devil Wears Prada is a 2006 American comedy-drama directed by David Frankel and produced by Wendy Finerman. Aline Brosh McKenna's screenplay is based on the 2003 novel by Lauren Weisberger.

disco-bloodbath-party-monster.intro: Disco Bloodbath: A Fabulous but True Tale of Murder in Clubland is a 1999 memoir by James St. James about his life as a Manhattan Club Kid and his friend Michael Alig. It was later retitled Party Monster, after the 2003 film.

duck-rock.intro: Duck Rock is an album by the British impresario Malcolm McLaren, first released in 1983 by Charisma Records, Virgin Records and Chrysalis Records.

elvira-mistress-of-the-dark.intro: Elvira, Mistress of the Dark is a 1988 American comedy horror film directed by James Signorelli, starring Cassandra Peterson as the horror host Elvira, who inherits a house in a prudish small town.

facts.label: Written by
facts.value: Cassandra Peterson, John Paragon and Sam Egan

emily-in-paris.intro: Emily in Paris is an American romantic comedy-drama series created by Darren Star for Netflix. Lily Collins plays Emily Cooper, an American marketing executive who moves to Paris.

first-ladies-of-disco.intro: First Ladies of Disco is an American supergroup formed in 2015, first made up of Martha Wash, Linda Clifford and Evelyn "Champagne" King.

flawless.intro: Flawless is a 1999 American crime drama written and directed by Joel Schumacher, starring Robert De Niro and Philip Seymour Hoffman.

facts.label: Produced by
facts.value: Joel Schumacher, Jane Rosenthal and Robert De Niro

frasier.intro: Frasier is an American sitcom broadcast on NBC for eleven seasons, from 1993 to 2004, created by David Angell, Peter Casey and David Lee.

facts.label: Created by
facts.value: David Angell, Peter Casey and David Lee

go.intro: "Go" is a song by Moby, released in March 1991 by the label Instinct as the first single from his debut album. It is built around a sample from the TV series Twin Peaks.

great-expectations.intro: Great Expectations is a 1998 American romantic drama directed by Alfonso Cuarón and written by Mitch Glazer, starring Ethan Hawke, Gwyneth Paltrow, Hank Azaria, Chris Cooper, Anne Bancroft and Robert De Niro.

grind.intro: The Grind is a dance music show broadcast on MTV between 1992 and 1997.

happy-clothes-a-film-about-patricia-fiel.intro: Happy Clothes: A Film About Patricia Field is a 2023 American documentary about the costume designer Patricia Field, produced and directed by Michael Selditch.

how-to-murder-your-life.intro: How to Murder Your Life is a memoir by the fashion and beauty journalist Cat Marnell. It was published in 2017 by Simon & Schuster and became a bestseller.

hunger.intro: The Hunger is a 1983 erotic horror film directed by Tony Scott in his directorial debut, starring Catherine Deneuve, David Bowie and Susan Sarandon. It is a loose adaptation of the 1981 novel of the same name by Whitley Strieber.

jesus-christ-superstar.intro: Jesus Christ Superstar is a sung-through rock opera with music by Andrew Lloyd Webber and lyrics by Tim Rice, loosely based on the Gospel accounts of the Passion.

joan-rivers-show.intro: The Joan Rivers Show is an American syndicated daytime talk show hosted by Joan Rivers. It ran for five seasons, from 5 September 1989 to 26 December 1993.

jubilee.intro: Jubilee is a 1978 British film directed by Derek Jarman. It stars Jenny Runacre, Ian Charleson, Nell Campbell, Hermine Demoriane and a host of punk rockers.

just-shoot-me.intro: Just Shoot Me! is an American sitcom that aired on NBC from 1997 to 2003.

kick.intro: Kick is the sixth studio album by the Australian rock band INXS, released on 12 October 1987. It was produced by Chris Thomas, recorded in Sydney and Paris and mixed at AIR Studios in London.

killing-fields.intro: The Killing Fields is a 1984 British drama about the Khmer Rouge regime in Cambodia, based on the experiences of the journalists Dith Pran and Sydney Schanberg. It was directed by Roland Joffé and produced by David Puttnam.

kominsky-method.intro: The Kominsky Method is an American comedy-drama series created by Chuck Lorre that premiered on Netflix in 2018. Michael Douglas plays an ageing acting coach who once had a brief moment of success as an actor.

late-night-with-david-letterman.intro: Late Night with David Letterman is an American late-night talk show broadcast by NBC from 1982 to 1993, the first edition of Late Night.

limelight-documentary.intro: Limelight is a 2011 documentary about the rise and fall of the New York City club owner Peter Gatien. It was produced by his daughter Jen Gatien and released in the United States and Canada on 23 September 2011.

madonna-secret-music-video.intro: "Secret" is a song by Madonna from her sixth studio album, Bedtime Stories. It was released by Maverick Records on 26 September 1994 as the album's lead single.

making-mr-right.intro: Making Mr. Right is a 1987 American science fiction romantic comedy directed by Susan Seidelman, starring John Malkovich as Jeff Peters/Ulysses and Ann Magnuson as Frankie Stone.

man-2-man.intro: Man 2 Man was an American hi-NRG band from New York City, formed in the early 1980s and best known for the hits "Male Stripper", "Energy Is Eurobeat" and "I Need a Man".

martha-wash-carry-on.intro: "Carry On" is a song by Martha Wash, released on 30 October 1992 by RCA Records as the lead single from her debut solo album Martha Wash. Written by Eric Beall, it went to No. 1 on the US Billboard Hot Dance Club Play chart.

martha-wash-give-it-to-you.intro: "Give It to You" is a song by Martha Wash, the second single from her debut album Martha Wash and the follow-up to "Carry On". It was written and produced by Brian Alexander Morgan.

martha-wash-martha-wash.intro: Martha Wash is the debut solo album by Martha Wash, released on 23 February 1993 by RCA Records.

miami-rhapsody.intro: Miami Rhapsody is a 1995 American romantic comedy written and directed by David Frankel, starring Sarah Jessica Parker, Gil Bellows, Antonio Banderas, Mia Farrow, Paul Mazursky and Kevin Pollak.

misandrists.intro: The Misandrists is a 2017 English-language German drama film directed by Bruce LaBruce. It was screened in the Panorama section of the 67th Berlin International Film Festival.

moby-doc.intro: Moby Doc is a 2021 American documentary about the life and career of Moby, co-written by Moby and Rob Gordon Bralver, who also directed it.

mondo-new-york.intro: Mondo New York is a 1988 documentary directed by Harvey Keith, a tour of the city's downtown underground inspired by the 1962 film Mondo Cane.

nomi-song.intro: The Nomi Song is a 2004 documentary about the life of the singer Klaus Nomi, written and directed by Andrew Horn. It premiered at the Berlin International Film Festival in February 2004, where it won the Teddy Award for best documentary.

ordinary-world.intro: "Ordinary World" is a song by Duran Duran, released on 19 December 1992 as the first single from their 1993 album Duran Duran, known as the Wedding Album.

party-monster.intro: Party Monster is a 2003 American biographical crime drama written and directed by Fenton Bailey and Randy Barbato. Macaulay Culkin plays Michael Alig, the "king of the Club Kids".

facts.label: Produced by
facts.value: Fenton Bailey, Randy Barbato, Jon Marcus and Christine Vachon

phil-donahue-show.intro: The Phil Donahue Show is an American daytime talk show hosted by Phil Donahue. It ran for 29 seasons, from 1967 to 1996.

pink-floyd-the-wall.intro: Pink Floyd – The Wall is a 1982 musical film directed by Alan Parker and based on Pink Floyd's 1979 album The Wall, with a screenplay by Roger Waters and animation by Gerald Scarfe.

porcelain.intro: Porcelain: A Memoir is a 2016 memoir by Moby, covering his youth in the 1970s until his worldwide success in the late 1990s with Play.

porcelain-moby.intro: "Porcelain" is a song by Moby, released in 2000 as the sixth single from his album Play (1999).

pulsallama.intro: Pulsallama was an all-woman no wave band from New York, "13 girls fighting over a cowbell": a percussion group with two bass guitars and several singers. It grew out of the Ladies Auxiliary of the Lower East Side at Club 57 in 1981.

queen-of-the-universe.intro: Queen of the Universe is a drag queen singing competition series produced by World of Wonder and hosted by Graham Norton, with four pop music judges.

real-sex.intro: Real Sex is a documentary series produced by HBO, a sexually explicit "magazine" that began in 1990. It was created by Sheila Nevins and produced by Patti Kaplan.

real-wild-child.intro: "Wild One", also known as "Real Wild Child", is an Australian rock and roll song written by Johnny Greenan, Johnny O'Keefe and Dave Owens. It was first a hit for O'Keefe in 1958, and Iggy Pop's version came out in 1986.

facts.label: Written by
facts.value: Johnny Greenan, Johnny O'Keefe and Dave Owens

rocky-horror-picture-show.intro: The Rocky Horror Picture Show is a 1975 musical comedy horror film directed by Jim Sharman and based on the 1973 stage musical The Rocky Horror Show by Richard O'Brien.

rocky-horror-show.intro: The Rocky Horror Show is a stage musical with music, lyrics and book by Richard O'Brien, a tribute to science fiction and horror B movies. It opened in London in 1973.

rupaul-s-drag-race.intro: RuPaul's Drag Race is an American reality competition series, the first in the Drag Race franchise, produced by World of Wonder. The show follows RuPaul's search for "America's next drag superstar".

rupaul-s-drag-race-all-stars.intro: RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars is the all-stars edition of RuPaul's Drag Race, produced by World of Wonder. It premiered on 22 October 2012 on Logo TV before moving to VH1.

rupaul-s-drag-race-down-under.intro: Drag Race Down Under is a New Zealand-Australian reality competition series based on RuPaul's Drag Race and part of the Drag Race franchise.

rupaul-s-drag-race-uk.intro: RuPaul's Drag Race UK is a British reality competition series based on the American show, made by the BBC and World of Wonder. It premiered on 3 October 2019.

rupaul-show.intro: The RuPaul Show is an American talk and variety show that premiered on VH1 in 1996. Hosted by RuPaul, it was one of the first national TV programs in the United States with an openly gay host.

saturday-night-fever.intro: Saturday Night Fever is a 1977 American dance drama directed by John Badham and produced by Robert Stigwood. John Travolta plays Tony Manero, a young Italian-American who spends his weekends dancing at a local disco in Brooklyn.

facts.label: Written by
facts.value: Norman Wexler, from a story by Nik Cohn

searching-for-the-young-soul-rebels.intro: Searching for the Young Soul Rebels is the debut album by Dexys Midnight Runners, released on 11 July 1980 by Parlophone and EMI. The band, led by Kevin Rowland, formed in Birmingham in 1978.

seduction.intro: Seduction is an American dance-pop and freestyle trio from New York put together by Robert Clivillés and David Cole, first made up of April Harris, Michelle Visage and Idalis DeLeón.

seduction-true-love.intro: "(You're My One and Only) True Love" is a single by Seduction. Although uncredited, the lead vocals were sung by Martha Wash.

seduction-two-to-make-it-right.intro: "Two to Make It Right" is a 1989 song by the girl group Seduction, from their first album Nothing Matters Without Love, with April Harris and Michelle Visage on lead vocals.

see-jungle-see-jungle-go-join-your-gang-.intro: See Jungle! See Jungle! Go Join Your Gang Yeah, City All Over! Go Ape Crazy! is a 1981 album by the British new wave band Bow Wow Wow.

seinfeld.intro: Seinfeld is an American sitcom created by Larry David and Jerry Seinfeld. It aired on NBC from 1989 to 1998, nine seasons and 180 episodes.

sex-and-the-city.intro: Sex and the City is an American romantic comedy-drama series created by Darren Star for HBO, based on Candace Bushnell's newspaper column and 1996 book. It ran from 1998 to 2004, six seasons and 94 episodes.

sex-and-the-city-the-movie.intro: Sex and the City is a 2008 American romantic comedy written and directed by Michael Patrick King, the film that follows the HBO series.

facts.label: Produced by
facts.value: Michael Patrick King, Darren Star and Sarah Jessica Parker

she-devil.intro: She-Devil is a 1989 American comedy directed by Susan Seidelman, written by Barry Strugatz and Mark R. Burns, and starring Meryl Streep, Roseanne Barr and Ed Begley Jr.

facts.label: Written by
facts.value: Barry Strugatz and Mark R. Burns

smithereens.intro: Smithereens is a 1982 American drama directed by Susan Seidelman and starring Susan Berman, Brad Rijn and Richard Hell.

sound-factory.intro: The Sound Factory was a nightclub at 532 West 27th Street, and later 618 West 46th Street, in Manhattan. It was a key venue of New York house music from 1989 to 1995.

sterile-cuckoo.intro: The Sterile Cuckoo is a 1969 American comedy-drama by producer-director Alan J. Pakula about an eccentric young couple whose relationship deepens despite their differences.

sugar-kane.intro: "Sugar Kane" is a song by Sonic Youth from their album Dirty (1992), released as the album's third single on 22 March 1993 by Geffen Records.

sylvester-you-make-me-feel.intro: "You Make Me Feel (Mighty Real)" is a song by the disco singer Sylvester, written by James Wirrick and Sylvester, produced by Harvey Fuqua and Sylvester, and released by Fantasy Records from the album Step II (1978).

then-it-fell-apart.intro: Then It Fell Apart is a 2019 memoir by Moby, following Porcelain (2016), which covered his life before fame.

tiger-king.intro: Tiger King is an American true crime documentary series about the zookeeper Joe Exotic. Its first season was released on Netflix on 20 March 2020.

to-wong-foo-thanks-for-everything-julie-.intro: To Wong Foo, Thanks for Everything! Julie Newmar is a 1995 American road comedy directed by Beeban Kidron, starring Wesley Snipes, Patrick Swayze and John Leguizamo as three New York City drag queens on a road trip.

facts.label: Produced by
facts.value: Walter F. Parkes and Bruce Cohen

toilet-boys.intro: Toilet Böys are an American rock and roll band from New York City. The original line-up was Miss Guy, Sean Pierce, Electric Eddie, Rocket and Adam Vomit.

truth-or-dare.intro: Madonna: Truth or Dare is a 1991 documentary directed by Alek Keshishian about Madonna's 1990 Blond Ambition World Tour.

ugly-betty.intro: Ugly Betty is an American comedy-drama series developed by Silvio Horta that aired on ABC from 2006 to 2010. It is based on the Colombian telenovela Yo soy Betty, la fea.

vogue.intro: "Vogue" is a 1990 song by Madonna from her album I'm Breathless. Written and produced by Madonna and Shep Pettibone, it was inspired by voguing, the dance made popular in New York City in the late 1980s.

watch-what-happens-live-with-andy-cohen.intro: Watch What Happens Live! with Andy Cohen is an American late-night talk show about pop culture, hosted by Andy Cohen on Bravo since 16 July 2009.

wayne-county-and-the-electric-chairs-fuc.intro: "Fuck Off", also released as "(If You Don't Wanna Fuck Me, Baby) Fuck Off!!", is the debut single by Wayne County & the Electric Chairs. It came out in 1977 on Sweet FA, an imprint of Safari Records.

weather-girls.intro: The Weather Girls are an American duo whose best-known line-up was Martha Wash and Izora Armstead. They began in San Francisco in 1976 as Two Tons O' Fun, the backing duo for the disco singer Sylvester.

weather-girls-it-s-raining-men.intro: "It's Raining Men" is a song by the disco duo the Weather Girls from their album Success. It was released as a single on 10 September 1982 by Columbia Records.

wedding-album.intro: Duran Duran, known as the Wedding Album, is the seventh studio album by Duran Duran, released on 15 February 1993 by Parlophone. It is the band's second album named after itself.

white-lines.intro: "White Lines (Don't Don't Do It)" is a 1983 song by the hip hop artist Melle Mel, a warning against cocaine. Duran Duran recorded their version for the 1995 album Thank You.

white-man-in-hammersmith-palais.intro: "(White Man) In Hammersmith Palais" is a song by the Clash, first released as a 7-inch single with the B-side "The Prisoner" on 16 June 1978 by CBS Records.

wigstock-the-movie.intro: Wigstock: The Movie is a 1995 documentary about Wigstock, the drag music festival held in New York City's East Village through the 1980s and 1990s. It shows performances from the 1994 festival by Crystal Waters, Deee-Lite, Jackie Beat, Debbie Harry, Leigh Bowery, Joey Arias, RuPaul and the Dueling Bankheads.

wings.intro: Wings is an American sitcom that ran for eight seasons on NBC, from 1990 to 1997.

facts.label: Created by
facts.value: David Angell, Peter Casey and David Lee

you-oughta-know.intro: "You Oughta Know" is a song by Alanis Morissette from her album Jagged Little Pill (1995). It was released in July 1995 by Maverick as the album's lead single.
